name: tpl-precedence-1-goal~p3
task: First move the ball off the door, then take the key, open the door with it and pick up the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a single ordered chain (move the ball, take the key, open the door, pick up the box). Existence(target_picked_up) plus the three hard Precedence clauses (blocker_moved before has_door_key, has_door_key before door_open, door_open before target_picked_up) force every earlier step, so no extra Existence clauses are needed, and all clauses are hard as the commanded wording requires.

texts: Pick up the target box (the mission's designated box) at some point in the episode.
Open the door only after the key has been taken, so the box is picked up after the door is opened.
Take the key before opening the door.
Move the ball off the door before taking the key.
